title: Eric Walker claimed Majestic 12 membership; Azadehdel conversation
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Eric Walker claimed Majestic 12 membership; Azadehdel conversation, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Eric Walker, a man connected to Penn State university, seemed to claim he was part of Majestic 12, a rumoured secret group of officials said to handle the UFO question. Michels ties this to a conversation Walker had with a man named Henry Azadehdel, and to work by a UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, because if true it would put a real person inside that group.
